stubbed: Not connected to the server yet.

members.title: Members
members.description: People who use Starr to discover and request.
members.emptyDescription: Create accounts directly or send invitation links. Members never see this admin area.
members.noCategoriesWarning: No category is switched on: they can sign in but cannot request anything until you switch one on.

addDialog.title: Add member
addDialog.description: They get a link to set their own password. Nothing is sent automatically.
addDialog.createdDescription: Send {{name}} this link to set a password. It works once and expires {{date}}.

invitations.title: Invitations
invitations.description: Links that let people create their own account.
invitations.emptyDescription: An invitation link expires and can preset what the person may request.
invitations.revokeText: The link stops working at once. This cannot be undone; create a new invitation if they still need one.
invitations.linkOnce: Links are shown only once, when created. Revoke and create a new one if a link got lost.

dialog.title: Create invitation
dialog.description: Anyone with the link can create one account until it expires.
dialog.usernameHint: Optional. Leave empty to let them choose.
dialog.createdDescription: Copy this link now; Starr can't show it again. It expires {{date}}.
dialog.accountsHint: If this friend already has an account in a media server, name it: accepting links it and it keeps its password. Elsewhere Starr creates a new account.

services.title: Services
services.emptyDescription: Connect Radarr, Sonarr, Lidarr or Whisparr first. Starr checks connection and version in the background.

form.name: Name
form.nameHint: Shown in Starr only, e.g. “Movies” or “Radarr 4K”.
form.baseUrlHint: Address Starr uses to reach the service, including any URL base, e.g. {{example}}.
form.apiKeyHint: Radarr, Sonarr, Lidarr and Whisparr: Settings → General → Security. Stored encrypted; never shown again.
form.apiKeyKeep: Leave empty to keep the stored key.
form.apiKeyNewServer: The URL points to another server: enter the API key again. Starr never sends the stored key to a new server.
form.loginNewServer: The URL points to another server: enter the username and password again. Starr never sends the stored login to a new server.
form.addDescription: Starr stores the connection and checks it in the background.
form.editDescription: A new URL or API key triggers a fresh check.
form.apiKeyHintTmdb: TMDB: Settings → API → “API Read Access Token” (the long one, not the 32-character API key). Stored encrypted; never shown again.
form.baseUrlHintTmdb: TMDB's API address; keep the default.
form.baseUrlHintMusicBrainz: MusicBrainz's address; keep the default unless you run a mirror. Lists come from ListenBrainz, covers from the Cover Art Archive.
form.noKeyMusicBrainz: MusicBrainz needs no key. Starr identifies itself as “Starr/version ( https://github.com/bitoxo/starr )” and sends nothing about you; it keeps to one request per second.
form.apiKeyHintLibrary: Jellyfin: Dashboard → API Keys. Emby: Settings → API Keys. Starr only reads libraries with it. Stored encrypted; never shown again.
form.usernameHint: Navidrome has no API keys: Starr signs in as an administrator (a dedicated “starr” admin is best) and only reads libraries and albums. Stored encrypted.
form.loginKeep: Leave username and password empty to keep the current login.
form.passwordHint: Kept exactly as typed; never shown again.
form.publicUrlHint: Address members open titles at, e.g. https://watch.example.com. The URL above stays internal.
form.publicUrlMissing: Without a public URL, members get no "Open in" link for this service.
form.baseUrlHintStashDb: The stash-box address, usually https://stashdb.org. Starr asks it for at most two things per second and sends nothing about you.
form.apiKeyHintStashDb: Your own StashDB API key (profile page), from an account that can only read: Starr refuses a key that could edit. Get the account and key through StashDB’s own invite process; you are responsible for following its rules. Stored encrypted; never shown again.

delete.title: Remove {{name}}?
delete.description: Starr forgets this connection and its stored API key. Nothing changes in the service itself.
delete.inUse: It is in use. Removing it takes away:
delete.unknownUse: Starr could not check which categories use it, so type its name to be sure.

role.catalog: {{category}}: the catalog members discover and search in
role.source: {{category}}: the source requests go to (requests close until you set another)
role.consume: {{category}}: where members watch, and the accounts Starr manages there

errors.credentials_invalid: The service rejected the API key.
errors.transient: Starr could not reach the service. Check the URL and that it is running.
errors.throttled: The service asked Starr to slow down. The next check will try again.
errors.not_found: Nothing answered at this URL. Check the URL base.
errors.version_unsupported: This version is outside the range Starr was tested with. Starr stays read-only.
errors.unknown: The service answered in an unexpected way. Is this the right service?
errors.credentials_unreadable: Starr's secret key changed, so the stored API key can no longer be read. Re-enter the API key.
errors.adapter_unknown: This Starr version does not support this service type.
errors.services_name_taken: A service with this name already exists.
errors.services_musicbrainz_exists: MusicBrainz is connected already. Starr talks to it through one connection only, to stay within its limit of one request per second.
errors.services_secrets_unavailable: The background worker has not initialised the secret key yet. Try again shortly.
errors.validation_base_url: Enter a full http(s) URL without credentials, query or fragment.
errors.validation_api_key: The API key may only contain visible ASCII characters.
errors.validation_login: Enter the admin username and password (no line breaks).
errors.unavailable: Something went wrong. Try again in a moment.
errors.validation_public_url: Enter a full http(s) URL without credentials, query or fragment, or leave it empty.
errors.validation_tmdb_read_token: This is TMDB's API key. Paste the API Read Access Token instead (Settings → API on themoviedb.org).
errors.catalog_key_unavailable: This worker has no web key, so it cannot open the TMDB token. Mount web.key into the worker container (read-only).
errors.services_stashdb_exists: StashDB is connected already. Starr talks to it through one connection only, to stay within its limit.
errors.validation_stashdb_not_read_only: This StashDB account can do more than read. Use a read-only StashDB account.
errors.services_check_unavailable: Starr could not reach the service to check the key. Check the URL and try again.
errors.validation_credential_required_for_new_o: This URL points to another server. Enter its API key (or login) again: Starr never sends the stored one to a new server.

writes.pausedToast: Writes to {{name}} paused. Approved requests wait.
writes.resumedToast: Writes to {{name}} resumed. Held requests go out now.

writes.confirmDescription_other: {{count}} approved titles will go to {{name}} now:
writes.confirmStopsOnly: Held stops will go to {{name}} now:

runs.description: Background jobs with progress and reports.
runs.emptyDescription: Checks and other background jobs show up here as soon as they start.

failedPlain.failed: The run failed. Starr tries again if the job allows another attempt; the details say why.
failedPlain.aborted: The run was stopped before it finished, for example because the worker restarted.

detail.title: Run {{id}}
detail.noReport: No report: runs without a report count as failed.
detail.loadFailed: This run could not be loaded.

attribution.title: Data sources
attribution.tmdbNotice: Starr uses TMDB and the TMDB APIs but is not endorsed, certified, or otherwise approved by TMDB.
attribution.justwatch: Streaming availability is provided by JustWatch.
attribution.musicbrainzCore: Artists, albums, tracklists and release dates come from MusicBrainz, core data under
attribution.musicbrainzGenres: Genres of albums and artists, and the music genre lanes, are MusicBrainz supplementary data under

attribution.listenbrainzText: Fresh releases and the order of the music genre lanes come from ListenBrainz listens, data under

memberDetail.entitlementsDescription: What this member can request per category. Takes effect once requests arrive.
memberDetail.adultHint: Off by default. Only admins can switch it on.

adultConfirm.title: Switch NSFW on for {{name}}?
adultConfirm.text: Your operator statement says you enable it only for adults who want it. Confirm that {{name}} is an adult and wants to see this category. It takes effect when you save.

memberDetail.suspendHint: Signs them out everywhere at once. You can reactivate any time.
memberDetail.suspendText: They are signed out on every device at once and cannot sign in until you reactivate them. Media server accounts Starr manages are disabled once account writes are live.
memberDetail.reactivateHint: Lets them sign in again with their password. Media server accounts Starr manages are enabled again.
memberDetail.resetPasswordHint: Earlier links stop working. Their current password keeps working until they use the new link.
memberDetail.resetDescription: Send this link to {{name}}. It works once and expires {{date}}.
memberDetail.deleteHint: Members who never signed in are removed at once. Everyone else stays restorable for the grace period.
memberDetail.deleteDescription: They are signed out immediately. If they have used Starr, they stay restorable until the grace period ends; after that only their username remains, reserved.
memberDetail.deletePreviewHint: Only while account writes there are live. A member who never used Starr is removed at once instead, and accounts they were linked to stay as they are.
memberDetail.deleteAccountGoes: {{service}}: “{{name}}” is disabled and, when the grace period ends, deleted.
memberDetail.deleteAccountReleased: {{service}}: “{{name}}” was linked, not created by Starr: it is disabled and released when the grace period ends, never deleted.
memberDetail.deleteAccountStays: {{service}}: “{{name}}” stays as it is (ignored or an admin there).
memberDetail.restored: Member restored. They stay suspended until you reactivate them.

libraries.title: Libraries
libraries.description: What this member gets in each media server, from their categories. Written to a server only once its account writes are live.
libraries.none: No library here: none of their categories is watched in this server.
libraries.unmapped: {{categories}}: no libraries chosen yet, so nothing from there.
libraries.empty: No media server is set up to watch in.

memberDetail.accountsHint: What Starr does for this member in each media server. Servers whose account writes are not live only show the plan.

security.title: Security
security.description: Two-step verification, your password, where you are signed in, and your member profile.
security.passwordText: Changing it signs you out on every other device.
security.passwordChanged: Password changed. Your other sessions are signed out.
security.sessionsFailed: Your sessions could not be loaded. Try again in a moment.
security.unlinkText: You can no longer switch into the member view without signing in again. Linking the profile again asks for the member's password.
security.required: This server requires two-step verification for every admin. Set it up to continue.
security.totpOffText: Sign-ins ask for a code from an authenticator app (1Password, Aegis, Google Authenticator, …) after your password.
security.totpOnText: Sign-ins ask for a code from your authenticator app.
security.scan: Scan this code with your authenticator app, or enter the key by hand.
security.qrAlt: QR code for your authenticator app
security.codesText: Each code signs you in once if you lose your phone. They are shown only now.
security.disableText: Confirm with your password and a current code (or a recovery code). Your recovery codes stop working. Account writes to media servers that are live pause until every admin has two-step verification again.
security.memberText: Link your own member profile to switch into the member view without a second login. Linking asks for that profile's password; switching back asks for your admin password and, with two-step verification on, a code.
security.regenerateText: Confirm with your password and a current code from your authenticator app. Your old recovery codes stop working.

admins.title: Admin accounts
admins.description: People who run this Starr. Admins never get accounts in services.

addDialog.title: Add admin
addDialog.description: They get a link to set their own password. Nothing is sent automatically.
addDialog.createdDescription: Send {{name}} this link to set a password. It works once and expires {{date}}.
addDialog.totpWarning: Until the new admin turns on two-step verification, live account writes to media servers pause by themselves; the Inbox offers to resume them once every admin has it.

admins.removeDescription: They can no longer sign in. The username stays reserved, because the audit log names it.
admins.suspendText: They are signed out everywhere at once and cannot sign in until an admin reactivates them.

categories.title: Categories
categories.description: What Starr offers per category, where requests go and what members discover.

errors.unavailable: Categories could not be loaded. Try again in a moment.

discover.noRelevance: Discover waits for a saved relevance

roles.title: Services
roles.description: Which connected service does what for this category.
roles.catalogHint: Discover, search and metadata. The default is the one members see.
roles.sourceHint: Approved requests go here. One per category.
roles.consumeHint: Where members open what is available.

add.consume: Add a service to watch in

noCandidates.catalog: No further catalog connected. Add TMDB (movies, series) or MusicBrainz (music) under Services.
noCandidates.source: No suitable source connected. Add Radarr (movies), Sonarr (series), Lidarr (music) or Whisparr v3 (NSFW) under Services.
noCandidates.consume: No Jellyfin or Emby connected. Add one under Services to show members where to watch.

roles.noPublicUrl: No public URL: members get no "Open in" link here. Set one under Services.
roles.writesPaused: Writes paused: Starr sends nothing to this source, approved requests wait. Resume under Services.

followCap.title: Follows
followCap.description: Members follow performers and studios; Starr asks for their new scenes in the member's name.
followCap.label: Automatic requests per follow and week
followCap.hint: Counted per follow over the last 7 days. More new scenes are shown to the member to request themselves. Applies from the next daily check.

relevance.title: Relevance
relevance.description: Discover shows titles that match these settings; search always finds everything.
relevance.languagesHint: Trending, Popular and Top rated show titles originally in one of these.
relevance.releaseRegionHint: Its release dates count for Upcoming.
relevance.notSaved: Not saved yet: Discover stays off for this category.
relevance.needsCatalog: Add a catalog under Services first.

music.description: Which kinds of releases count: they fill Fresh releases and an artist's default discography, and later decide what following an artist asks for. Search always finds everything.
music.releaseTypesHint: Shown by default. None chosen means every type.
music.secondaryTypesHint: Releases of these kinds stay behind “Show all”.

preview.title: Trending preview
preview.hint: Trending follows TMDB's weekly trend and is filtered by original language only.
preview.hintMusic: Trending is ListenBrainz' sitewide chart of the week; release types do not filter it.
preview.empty: No trending title matches these languages this week.

source.settingsDescription: Applied to everything Starr adds to the source for this category.
source.needsSource: Set a source under Services first.
source.minimumAvailabilityHint: When Radarr starts looking for a movie.
source.requestsClosed: Requests stay closed until a quality profile and root folder are saved.
source.requestsClosedMetadata: Requests stay closed until a quality profile, metadata profile and root folder are saved.
source.metadataProfileHint: Which release types Lidarr keeps for an artist Starr adds. Starr only monitors the albums members request.
source.metadataProfileExcludes: This profile drops albums or EPs: Lidarr may remove a requested album again on its next refresh. Pick one that allows Album, EP and Studio.

switch.title: Switch source
switch.description: New requests go to the new source. Open requests finish where they started.
switch.openRequests_one: {{count}} open request keeps finishing at the current source.
switch.openRequests_other: {{count}} open requests keep finishing at the current source.

categories.musicAvailability: Members request albums; Lidarr gets exactly those, never the rest of the artist.

offConfirm.title: Switch {{name}} off?
offConfirm.text: Members no longer see {{name}} in Discover or search and cannot request it. Open requests stay as they are; switching on again brings everything back.
offConfirm.textAdult: The private area closes for every member at once and the operator statement is cleared: switching on again asks for it. Cached private data is deleted.

categories.adultOptIn: Members see NSFW content only once you enable it for them one by one. Switching the category on enables it for nobody.

statement.title: Operator statement
statement.description: NSFW switches on only with this statement. It is stored with your name and the time; switching NSFW off clears it, so it is asked again next time.
statement.legal: Adult content is legal where I operate this server.
statement.adults: I will only enable it for adults who want it.
statement.responsible: I am responsible for the content and the sources I connect.
statement.missingHint: Switched on without the operator statement: the private category stays closed for everybody until you confirm it.

libraries.label: Libraries
libraries.noneHint: Choose which libraries hold this category. Until then availability counts every library not chosen for another category, and members get no library here.
libraries.dialogDescription: Members entitled to this category get exactly these libraries, never all of them. A library belongs to one category per server.
libraries.notListed: No libraries listed yet. Scan the server to read them.
libraries.listFailed: The last library listing failed: {{reason}} The list shows the last successful one.
libraries.scanQueued: Scan queued. The list updates when it is done.

removeRole.catalogSettings: Its relevance settings are deleted (regions, providers, languages, excluded genres); adding it back starts from scratch.
removeRole.lastCatalog: {{category}} has no catalog then: members can no longer discover, search or request it until you add one.
removeRole.otherCatalogs: Members keep discovering through the other catalog.
removeRole.consume: The libraries chosen for {{category}} in {{name}} are forgotten, and members no longer get “Open in {{name}}” for it.

removeSource.title: Remove {{name}} as the source of {{category}}?
removeSource.switchHint: To move to another source without closing requests, use “Switch” instead.
removeSource.done: {{name}} is no longer the source. Its settings are kept.

needsYou.title: Needs you
needsYou.description: Requests waiting for your approval, oldest first, libraries without a category, albums no music library lists, and account changes that wait for you or failed.
needsYou.emptyDescription: New requests from members with approval mode show up here.
needsYou.skipped_one: {{count}} request was decided or withdrawn meanwhile
needsYou.skipped_other: {{count}} requests were decided or withdrawn meanwhile

unlisted.title: Albums no music library lists
unlisted.description: The source has the files, but for over an hour no music library lists an album with this MusicBrainz ID. Starr matches albums only by their MusicBrainz release group, never by name, so members still see them as almost ready.
unlisted.hint: Lidarr does not tag files by default. Turn on “Tag Audio Files with Metadata” in Lidarr’s settings (new files or all files) so the files carry their MusicBrainz IDs, check that the library covers Lidarr’s music folder, then rescan the library.

rejectDialog.description: The member sees your reason. A declined request stays declined, even if the title arrives another way; there is no undo.
rejectDialog.placeholder: e.g. We only keep this one on disc

revokeDialog.description: The member sees your reason and is notified; their next request for it needs your approval. Nothing is deleted: if nobody else wants it, Starr only turns off the monitoring it switched on. A running download is left alone.
revokeDialog.placeholder: e.g. Not something we keep on this server

needsYou.revokeSkipped_one: {{count}} request had nothing open any more
needsYou.revokeSkipped_other: {{count}} requests had nothing open any more

libraries.title: Unmapped libraries
libraries.description: These libraries belong to no category, so no member gets them. Assign each to a category or mark it as belonging to none.
libraries.noRole: No category watches in this server yet.
libraries.ignored: {{name}} marked as belonging to no category

held.noRecentRun: No complete live run in the last hour; the next changes wait for your approval.
held.overCap_one: {{count}} step disables an account or takes libraries away, more than {{cap}} per run.
held.overCap_other: {{count}} steps disable accounts or take libraries away, more than {{cap}} per run.
held.overCapRecent_one: {{count}} more step that disables, deletes or takes libraries away, after {{recent}} in the last hour; more than {{cap}} within an hour.
held.overCapRecent_other: {{count}} more steps that disable, delete or take libraries away, after {{recent}} in the last hour; more than {{cap}} within an hour.

code.transient: The server did not answer; Starr tries again with the next run.
code.throttled: The server asked Starr to slow down; Starr tries again later.
code.credentials_invalid: The server refused Starr's API key. Check it under Services.
code.not_found: The account no longer exists in the server.
code.unknown: The server answered unexpectedly; the change may not have landed.
code.other: The change did not go through.

accounts.withoutPasswordHint: Creating the account did not finish. Starr keeps it disabled; it is finished once the member activates with their password (they are asked in My services).
accounts.conflictsTitle: Accounts Starr cannot manage right now

conflict.nameTaken: Another account already has this name there. Link it, or decide no account.
conflict.privileged: The account has admin rights in the server now. Starr keeps its hands off until you remove them there or unlink it.
conflict.missing: The server no longer lists the account. Starr creates no second one; check the server, then decide again.
conflict.missingSince: The server no longer lists the account (last seen {{when}}). Starr creates no second one; check the server, then decide again.
conflict.lockedByService: The server locked the account after failed sign-ins. Starr never lifts that; unlock it in the server if it is fine.

accounts.deviationsHint: Someone changed these accounts in the server since Starr last set them. The next live run sets them back; pause the writes first if the change was on purpose.
accounts.staleTitle: Libraries the server no longer lists
accounts.staleHint: A library mapped to a category is gone from the server, often because it was renamed (Jellyfin gives a renamed library a new ID). Members cannot get it; map the library again.

closed.title: Categories not taking requests
closed.description: Switched on, but members cannot request here: the source is missing or a setting is not chosen, for example after a source was removed or its new URL leads to a server without the chosen profile or folder.
closed.incomplete: {{name}} needs a quality profile, root folder or metadata profile.

needsYou.reasonMissing: Write a reason the member can read.

requests.title: Requests
requests.description: Every request with its member, and what the sources are doing.
requests.emptyDescription: Requests appear here as soon as members ask for something.
requests.loadFailed: The request could not be loaded.

detail.title: Request #{{id}}
detail.hiddenByMember: The member hid this request from their list.
detail.held: Held: {{source}} writes are paused. It goes out once you resume them.

requests.downloadsDescription: What the sources are fetching, with held, failed and stuck downloads.
requests.selectionMixed: Some selected requests have no action in common; each button names how many it acts on.

acquisitions.emptyDescription: Approved requests show up here once Starr hands them to Radarr or Sonarr.
acquisitions.held: Writes to {{name}} are paused. Sent once they are resumed.
acquisitions.unwanted: Unwanted: nobody asks for it any more. The download runs on until the file lands or it goes away.
acquisitions.stopPending: Stop monitoring waits to be sent to {{name}}.
acquisitions.stopHeld: Stop monitoring held: writes to {{name}} are paused.

errors.generic: The last message did not go out. Check the settings and send a test.
errors.no_address: There is no address to send to. Enter an admin address or a sender address.
errors.settings_invalid: The stored settings are incomplete. Fill in the form and save again.

kinds.import_blocked: An import is blocked at the source
kinds.account_privileged: A managed account gained admin rights in a media server
kinds.account_locked: A media server locked a managed account

test.failed: The test failed. The reason is shown with the channel.

email.title: Email
email.description: One SMTP server for member emails. Members choose in their profile what they get by email.
email.name: Email
email.removeText: Members get notifications in Starr only, and admin emails stop. The stored password is deleted; adding the server again asks for it.
email.none: No email server yet. Members get notifications in Starr only.
email.usernameHint: Leave empty if the server needs no login.
email.passwordKept: Stored. Leave empty to keep it.
email.adminAddressHint: Admin notifications by email go here; empty: none. Tests go here too, else to the sender.

hooks.description: Admin notifications to Discord or any service that takes JSON.
hooks.emptyDescription: Add a Discord channel webhook to hear about waiting approvals and failed downloads.
hooks.addDescription: The URL is stored encrypted; only the worker can read it.
hooks.name: Name
hooks.urlHint: In Discord: channel settings → Integrations → Webhooks → Copy URL.
hooks.removeText: Admin notifications stop going there. The stored URL is deleted; adding the webhook again needs it.

notificationSettings.title: Notifications

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.description: Who gets which account in your media servers, and what Starr does there. Every server starts plan only: Starr writes nothing until you go live with the plan in view.
accounts.emptyDescription: Connect Jellyfin or Emby under Services and let a category watch in it; Starr then lists its accounts here.
accounts.neverScanned: Not scanned yet. Starr scans these servers every 15 minutes, or now.
accounts.noAccounts: The last scan found no accounts.
accounts.incompleteHint: Some accounts could not be read safely; Starr marks nothing as gone until a scan is complete.
accounts.failedHint: The last scan failed ({{reason}}). The list shows what Starr knew before.

hint.admin: Administrator in the server. Starr never manages it.
hint.locked: Locked after failed logins. Starr never lifts a lockout.
hint.gone: Missing from two complete scans since {{when}}; removed from this list after 30 days.
hint.missing: Missing from the last complete scan; gone after a second one.
hint.ignored: Ignored by {{admin}} on {{when}}. Starr leaves it alone.

suggestion.hint: Same name as this Starr member. Only a suggestion: nothing is linked.

errors.actionFailed: That did not work. Try again.

accounts.linkedHint: Linked to this Starr member: Starr manages the account for them.

planHint.undecided: Starr does nothing for this member here until you decide.
planHint.noAccount: You decided this member gets no account here.
planHint.ignored: The account is ignored; Starr leaves it alone.
planHint.notNeeded: Not active or no category on this server: no account needed.
planHint.waitingForListing: The last scan was not complete; Starr creates nothing until it is.
planHint.waitingForLibraries: A category this member has maps no library on this server yet. Map it under Categories.
planHint.toCreate: Starr will create the account once the member enters their password.
planHint.lockedByService: The server locked it after failed logins. Starr never lifts a lockout.
planHint.nameTaken: Another account already has this name. Link it, or choose no account.
planHint.privileged: The account has admin rights in the server. Starr never touches it.

reason.librariesDiffer: libraries differ from the member's categories
reason.passwordMissing: no password reached the new account yet; stays disabled until the member activates
reason.passwordChanged: the member changed their Starr password; waits for them to enter it
reason.passwordSwitch: the member asked to use their Starr password here
reason.deletionDue: the member's deletion grace period is over
reason.lockedByStarr: Starr locked the account with a random password (the server has no off switch); the member's password unlocks it

plan.title: Plan
plan.none: Not planned yet. Starr plans after every scan.
plan.incomplete: Based on an incomplete scan: Starr would create nothing until a scan is complete.

matrix.title: Who gets which account
matrix.hint: Equal names are only suggestions. Members who existed before a server got accounts stay undecided until you choose; Starr creates nothing for them.
matrix.lockedByStarr: locked with a random password; the member's password unlocks it
matrix.disablesByPassword: {{servers}} has no off switch for accounts. Starr disables an account there by setting a random password nobody knows, and enables it again only with the member's next password (they are asked to activate in My services).

link.title: Link an account in {{server}}
link.confirmedUntil: Confirmed until {{time}}: linking runs without asking again.
link.description: The account keeps its password until {{member}} switches to the Starr password. Nothing is changed in the server now.
link.empty: No account can be linked: admins, ignored, gone and already linked accounts are left out.

writes.title: Account writes

totp.title: Two-factor authentication first
totp.you: Going live, resuming and approving need two-factor authentication for every active admin. Set it up for your account first.
totp.others: Going live, resuming and approving need two-factor authentication for every active admin. Still without it: {{names}}.

next.planOnly: Nothing is written to {{name}}. Go live once the plan below is what you want.
next.paused: Paused: plans keep updating, nothing is written to {{name}} until you resume.
next.incomplete: The last scan of {{name}} was incomplete: nothing is written until a scan is complete.
next.noRecentRun: Waits for you: no complete live run in the last hour. Starr does not undo changes made in {{name}} meanwhile without asking.
next.overCap_one: Waits for you: {{count}} step disables an account or takes libraries away, more than {{cap}} per run.
next.overCap_other: Waits for you: {{count}} steps disable accounts or take libraries away, more than {{cap}} per run.
next.overCapRecent_one: Waits for you: {{count}} more step that disables, deletes or takes libraries away, after {{recent}} in the last hour; more than {{cap}} within an hour.
next.overCapRecent_other: Waits for you: {{count}} more steps that disable, delete or take libraries away, after {{recent}} in the last hour; more than {{cap}} within an hour.
next.execute: Live: the next run applies the plan below in {{name}}.

writes.pausedAuto: Paused automatically {{when}}: an active admin had no two-factor authentication

done.goLive: {{name}} is live: Starr applies the plan now.
done.approve: Plan approved: Starr applies it in {{name}} now.

goLive.title: Go live in {{name}}?
goLive.description: Starr applies exactly this plan, then keeps {{name}} in sync: it enables, disables and narrows library access of the accounts you decided on.

resume.title: Resume writes to {{name}}?
resume.description: These changes piled up while the writes were paused. Starr applies exactly this plan.

approve.title: Approve this plan for {{name}}?
approve.description: Starr held this plan back. Approving applies exactly these changes once.

confirm.nothing: Nothing to change right now; Starr keeps the server in sync from here.
confirm.creates_one: {{count}} new account is created once the member enters their password.
confirm.creates_other: {{count}} new accounts are created once the members enter their passwords.
confirm.never: Starr never touches administrators, ignored accounts or accounts the server locked after failed logins.
confirm.passwords: Passwords are only written when a member enters theirs in Starr; Starr keeps no copy.

effects.sourceSettingsRechecked: {{category}} keeps its quality profile, root folder and metadata profile. Starr reads the lists at the new URL; if that server does not offer one of them (another {{service}}), Starr clears it, {{category}} stops taking requests until you choose again, and Needs you shows it.
effects.requestsClose: {{category}} stops taking requests until it has a source again.
effects.openRequestsFinish_one: {{count}} request already sent to {{service}} keeps finishing there.
effects.openRequestsFinish_other: {{count}} requests already sent to {{service}} keep finishing there.
effects.settingsKept: Its settings (quality profile, root folder and the rest) are kept: they come back when you set {{service}} as the source of {{category}} again, checked against what {{service}} offers then.

inbox.title: Inbox
inbox.loadFailed: The inbox could not be loaded. Check that Starr is running, then try again.
inbox.allClearDescription: No approvals, failures or paused writes. New requests show up here and in the bell.

sectionHint.fix: Something failed and needs a hand
sectionHint.paused: Writes are paused, so requests and account changes wait

inbox.declineMissing: Add a reason. The member reads it.
inbox.declineHint: A declined request stays declined; there is no undo.
inbox.approvedManyHeld_one: {{count}} request approved, held until writes resume
inbox.approvedManyHeld_other: {{count}} requests approved, held until writes resume
inbox.approvedPrivateHeld: Private request approved – held until {{source}} resumes
inbox.undone: Approval undone: waiting for you again
inbox.undoTooLate: Too late to undo: it went to the source already. Revoke the request instead.
inbox.skipped_one: {{count}} request was decided or withdrawn meanwhile
inbox.skipped_other: {{count}} requests were decided or withdrawn meanwhile

private.hidden: Details stay hidden until you show them.
private.lead: This request is in the private category. Names and images stay hidden until you show them on this screen.
private.showLabel: Show the details of private request #{{id}}
private.confirm: Shows images and names of the private category on this screen until it closes after 30 minutes without activity, or until you close it.

failed.title: {{title}}
failed.next: Fix what the technical details name in {{source}}, then submit again.

stuck.sentence: Stuck at {{source}}: the download does not move on.
stuck.next: Check it in {{source}}. Once it fails there, submit it again here.

closed.title: {{category}} stopped taking requests
closed.incomplete: {{source}} lacks a setting (quality profile or root folder), for example after its address changed. Choose it again to reopen {{category}}.
closed.noSource: {{category}} has no source. Add one to reopen it.

conflict.title: {{service}} account for {{username}}
conflict.nameTaken: The name is already taken in {{service}}, so no account was created.

deviation.title: {{username}} in {{service}}
deviation.hint: Changed in the server since Starr's last write; the next live run undoes it.

library.where: {{server}} · {{content}}: belongs to no category, so no member gets it.

stale.title: {{category}} library gone from {{service}}
stale.hint: Renamed or removed there; accounts cannot be given it. Map the library again.

writes.pausedAuto: Paused automatically {{when}}: an admin without two-step verification was added or turned it off.
writes.heldIntro_one: {{count}} approved request waits until you resume:
writes.heldIntro_other: {{count}} approved requests wait until you resume:
writes.stopsIntro_one: {{count}} stop (turn off monitoring) waits as well.
writes.stopsIntro_other: {{count}} stops (turn off monitoring) wait as well.
writes.accountsWait: Account changes wait until you resume.
writes.cleared: Every active admin has two-step verification now, so you can resume.
writes.waitsFor: Resuming waits until {{names}} turns on two-step verification.
writes.resumed: Writes to {{service}} resumed. Held requests go out now.

step.two_step: Turn on two-step verification for your account

inbox.openGone: Nothing waits for this any more.
